What's next · Merck

Defend Keytruda's narrative

Merck has earned the highest net sentiment — but with #CancerCalculus and "AstraZeneca vs Merck" framing rising, the next 60 days are about getting ahead of the pricing-power story before the press writes it for you.

→ 01
Pre-bunk Keytruda pricing

Build a patient-access story so the next #CancerCalculus thread has counter-narrative oxygen.

→ 02
Respond to UK contrast

AstraZeneca's £300M U-turn made Merck look immobile. A counter-investment signal would reset the framing.

→ 03
Steal BMS's radio playbook

BMS's "No Time to Wait" is generating 80% of its reach. Merck could replicate for Gardasil or Lynparza awareness.

→ 04
Compare to J&J

J&J's higher volume hides higher noise — Merck is more concentrated, which is both opportunity and risk.
